Subject: Request: SOC 2 / DPA walkthrough + pen-test overview

Hi Jasmine,

Hope you’re well — we’re moving toward kickoff for our internal audit and need a combined walkthrough covering your SOC 2 scope, DPA controls, and the pen-test onboarding checklist. We’d like to invite our security and procurement leads.

Are you able to run a 60-75 minute session the week of Nov 29 or the week after? Our constraints: prefer 15:00–18:00 UTC windows (APAC team needs to avoid evenings).

Also: can you share a short evidence index and the latest DPA redlines before the call so we can circulate internally? I attached our initial question list.

Thanks,
